policy.allocator: group_histogram_greedy_v1; repeated groups then exact singleton quota fill
policy.cross_protocol_roles: main and low-resource train/validation roles may differ; test is identical per seed
policy.duplicate_policy: retain records and original labels; keep group in one partition
policy.extreme_test: Kazakh original rating 1 or 5; reuse binary-trained models, no extreme-only fit
policy.low_nesting: hash-ranked records per language/class/role, independent of budget
policy.low_pools: 80/20 group-disjoint roles within the non-test development pool
policy.model_text: collapse_ws(raw_text); no added Unicode normalization or casefold
policy.sampling_failure: REVIEW_REQUIRED; no quota shrink, replacement, seed retry or resplitting
policy.sampling_unit_within_role: record; budgets may select part of a group but cannot move it across roles
policy.selection: source-only validation; joint = mean of the two language macro-F1 scores
policy.split_strata: language + reported domain + mapped three-class label
